title: Reindexing preserves failure probability
statement: Let $m,n$ be natural numbers, let $e:[m]\\to[n]$ be a bijection, let $f:\\{-1,1\\}^m\\to\\{\\pm1\\}$ be a Boolean function, let $\\delta\\in\\mathbb R$, and let $k$ be a natural number. The coordinate-switching failure probability at parameter $\\delta$ and threshold $k$ is the same for $f$ and for the function on $[n]$ obtained by reindexing its coordinates along $e$.
hypotheses_covered: Boolean function on the m-dimensional sign cube
